newsitem.title: USA: Zitel says owns about 35 pct of MatriDigm.
newsitem.headline: Zitel says owns about 35 pct of MatriDigm.

text.p: Zitel Corp said Thursday it owns about 35 percent of privately held MatriDigm Corp and that it does not expect that ownership will have a material impact on earnings in the 1996 fiscal year.
The company said in a statement it is difficult to predict the impact that its relationship with MatriDigm will have on earnings beyond 1996.
The company said it expects the general availability of MatriDigm's services will be announced by early 1997.
Zitel said that in addition to its investment stake in MatriDigm it also have a sales representative agreement in place with MatriDigm.
MatriDigm is using its technology to develop a solution to the "Millennium problem" which threatens to make obselete thousands of mainframe computers.
Mainframe computers, many built decades ago, were not programmed to recognize the year 2000 because their makers did not expect them to have to last that long.
Zitel specializes in the design, manufacture and marketing of high-performance mission-critical storage subsystems for relational databases.
